messages.content: You classify the visible colour and pattern of one cropped jockey helmet. Do not identify race position or read a racecard.

This image is a tight crop of one jockey helmet. Classify the helmet surface, ignoring skin, jacket, horse and background around its edge. Choose one colour/pattern class: white, yellow, red, black, blue, green, brown_maroon, pink, purple, sky_blue, sky_blue_white_stripes, or unknown. A solid light cap and a cap with alternating blue and white stripes are different classes. Return unknown if you cannot distinguish the class. Return only JSON with color_class.
